{unclassified-control:14}＊＊＊　冒険の１０の心得　＊＊＊

{unclassified-control:14}著者　　王様


１　自分とモンスターは順番に動く。
　　あせることなかれ！
２　道具を見たり　向きを変えるのは
　　動作したことにはならん！

３　にげるときは
　　敵のナナメ攻撃に注意せよ！
４　歩いているとHPは回復する。
　　あぶなくなったら　まずにげろ！

５　敵が寝ているか起きているかを
　　たしかめること！
　　すべてのモンスターを
　　たおす必要はない！

６　にげられない時は　ルーラ草をのむ！
　　まどわし草は　モンスターに投げる！
７　薬草や弟切草は　HPが最高のときに
　　のむと　最大HPが少し上がる。

８　いかずちの杖は　必ずあたる！
　　バシルーラの杖は　敵をとばす！
９　メダパニの杖は　フラフラにさせ
　　ラリホーの杖は　相手をねむらせる！

１０　毒で下がった「ちから」は
　　　毒けし草で　もとにもどす！
　　　ちからのたねは　そのあとでのむ！

entries.english_draft:
{center}*** Ten Tips for Adventurers ***

{center}By the King

1. You and the monsters take turns. Do not rush!

2. Checking your items or changing direction does not use up a turn.

3. When fleeing, watch out for enemies attacking diagonally!

4. Walking restores HP. When danger threatens, run away first!

5. Check if monsters are awake or asleep. You needn't defeat them all!

6. Drink a Zoom herb if trapped! Throw Misleader herbs at monsters!

7. At full HP, drinking a Medicinal herb or Super herb raises max HP a little.

8. A Lightning staff never misses! A Bazoom staff sends enemies away!

9. A Fuddle staff confuses your foe. A Snooze staff puts your foe to sleep!

10. Use an Antidotal herb to restore strength lost to poison.

Only then drink a Seed of strength!

{center}That is all.

Saruyama: This wonderful pot can combine weapons, shields and staves.

Saruyama: Numbers such as +3 are added together too.

Saruyama: However, you can't combine different kinds of items, such as a weapon and a shield.

Saruyama: For staves, combine two of the same kind to add their remaining charges together.

Saruyama: One last thing...

Saruyama: You can use R to put several items into a pot at once.

Saruyama: But when doing that with a Synthesis pot, be careful about the order!

Saruyama: Items go in from the top of your inventory down.

Saruyama: They aren't combined in the order you selected them, so take care.
